archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-09.2 Design Platform and Infrastructure Architecture
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once requirements are known, the organization designs the technical architecture that will meet them. This architecture defines how platforms, services, and technologies work together — both conceptually and physically.
It includes the data platform (data lake, data fabric, data market), processing environments (secure analysis zones, compute clusters), and access layers (APIs, portals, dashboards). The architecture defines integration patterns, security boundaries, identity management, and compliance zones.
The design is not static — it evolves over time, guided by architectural principles such as modularity, interoperability, reusability, and automation. At this point, diagrams, blueprints, and documentation are produced to guide implementation teams.
Value created: A coherent, future-proof technical blueprint that connects business needs with technological capabilities.
